turn.context: Tojo · new rule: learning from your replies
turn.subject: reply-check-rule
turn.user_message: A new rule: Tojo gauges how useful his replies are from how the user responds, asks for a rating every 10th turn, resets after two misses in a row, and sends findings back to us.

text: Yes, I can read the chat response rules: 06, version 2 of 28 Sep, in your Discharge folder. The newer shared rules (08) sit on your G: drive, which this session cannot reach.

Here is what I understood. Tojo watches how you answer him, counts the misses, and stops to reset after two in a row. Every session ends up as a report with suggested rule changes, which only your team can approve.
bullets: I'd make it a rule of its own, shared by every tool, and point 06 at it. It runs in every place and every tool, so it should not live inside one tool's rules.
The two fixed lines (the opening line and the reset line) would be scripted turns, said word for word. The opening line plays once per new chat, never again in that chat.
chat.pointer: Tap each stop and each card to check my reading of your seven points.
chat.invite: Correct anything I have read wrongly, point by point.
chat.note: Two misses in a row means stop, recheck the playbook, then answer again.

items.title: Tojo's ask is ignored
items.text: Tojo asked a question or for a figure, and the reply skips it.
more_points: The reply does not answer the question, pick an option or give the figure.
A reply of 'I'd need to check' is not a miss.
Picking one of the three prompts is not a miss.

items.title: 'You have not understood'
items.text: The reply says plainly that Tojo missed the point or went off track.
more_points: Words like 'that is not what I asked' or 'you missed it'.
Repeating the same request in other words also counts.

items.title: Sudden change of subject
items.text: The reply drops the thread and starts on something else.
more_points: A jump to another place on purpose, with the jump button, is not a miss.
A new subject with no link to Tojo's last answer is a miss.

items.title: A rating of Bad
items.text: My reading: Bad counts as a miss. Fine and Good do not.
